+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Security
+from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+import pytest
+
+app = FastAPI()
+oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token")
+
+def dep_b(token: str = Security(oauth2_scheme)):
+    return "B"
+
+def dep_a(token: str = Security(oauth2_scheme, scopes=["scope1"]), b = Depends(dep_b)):
+    return "A"
+
+@app.get("/route1")
+def route1(a = Depends(dep_a)):
+    return {"message": "route1"}
+
+@app.get("/route2")
+def route2(b = Depends(dep_b)):
+    return {"message": "route2"}
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_openapi():
+    openapi_schema = app.openapi()
+    
+    # Route 1 should have security: [{ "oauth2_scheme": ["scope1"] }]
+    # Route 2 should have security: [{ "oauth2_scheme": [] }]
+    
+    route1_security = openapi_schema["paths"]["/route1"]["get"]["security"]
+    route2_security = openapi_schema["paths"]["/route2"]["get"]["security"]
+    
+    print(f"Route 1 security: {route1_security}")
+    print(f"Route 2 security: {route2_security}")
+    
+    assert route1_security == [{"OAuth2PasswordBearer": ["scope1"]}]
+    assert route2_security == [{"OAuth2PasswordBearer": []}]
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_openapi()
